summary: Full test pass on the rebuilt /admin login (LE COFFRE). Backend pytest 5/6 passed (unauth /auth/me, bad pw 401, success login, real admin still works, cleanup); 1 failed = brute-force lockout never triggers from external URL. Frontend Playwright validated: (TEST1) form visible in 1.38s even with /auth/me delayed 8s, admin-login-checking indicator present during delay then disappears, 0 .loading elements (splash successfully removed); (TEST2) real login admin@goldenpirates.io/Capitaine1023! -> dashboard visible; (TEST3) wrong password shows inline admin-login-error 'Secret refusé — le coffre reste verrouillé.', typing clears it; (TEST5) offline -> 'La mer est agitée — vérifie ta connexion et réessaie.' and button re-clickable; (TEST6a) reload after login -> dashboard persists (12h cookie OK); (TEST7) no horizontal overflow at 1440x900, 768x1024, 390x844; (TEST8) FR title 'LE COFFRE DU CONSEIL' confirmed. TEST4 FAILED silently: 6 consecutive bad logins with fake email all returned 401, never 429 — DB shows requests were split across 2 pod IPs (10.81.4.212 and 10.81.4.213 each with fails=3), so the per-{ip}:{email} counter never reaches 5. The real client IP is masked by the k8s ingress; backend reads request.client.host (internal pod/proxy IP) instead of X-Forwarded-For.

critical.issue: Anti-brute-force lockout BROKEN behind k8s ingress. Backend uses request.client.host for the identifier, but each request is routed through a different internal proxy IP (10.81.4.212 / 10.81.4.213 observed). Across 6 real attempts fails stayed at 3/3 across two separate login_attempts documents, so the 5-fail threshold is NEVER reached and no 429 is ever returned to real external attackers. Fix: parse X-Forwarded-For first entry (fallback to request.client.host) for the identifier. Verified: db.login_attempts after test shows two docs with fails=3 for the same fake email.

rca of the issue: Repro: POST /api/admin/login with same email+bad password 6 times from the public URL. Expected: 6th call returns 429. Actual: all 6 return 401. db.login_attempts shows the attempts split into 2 documents by distinct internal proxy IPs. RCA: server.py line 293 uses request.client.host which, behind the k8s ingress-nginx proxying to 2+ backend pods (or 2+ upstream connections), is NOT the real client IP but the internal pod/proxy IP, and it rotates per request. The 5-fail counter is therefore partitioned across multiple identifiers and never trips. Mitigation: ident = (request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip() or (request.client.host if request.client else 'unknown')) + ':' + email.
